decision_rule_reachability.reason: Independently re-ran the hash-verified embedded runner's --reachability-probe (synthetic, non-substrate, non-outcome-bearing): all 8 class branches {STRICT-WIN-MEASURED, SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED, EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED, BOUNDED-WIN, MIXED-TRADEOFF, COST-FAIL, FUNCTIONAL-FAIL, COST-UNKNOWN} and all 6 aggregates {SUPPORTS, MIXED-PARTIAL, MIXED-COUNTER-DEPENDENT, MIXED, FALSIFIES, INCONCLUSIVE} were produced (all_class_branches_reachable=true, all_aggregate_branches_reachable=true). Precedence is first-match over nonempty regions: STRICT-SINGLE-EQUAL tier requires eq (pr_L2<1.00 AND pr_L3<1.00 AND fetch_L3<=0.90); BOUNDED-WIN is reachable from eq-false rows with pr<=1.00 (e.g. pr_L2==1.00); MIXED-TRADEOFF/COST-FAIL from successively worse rows; no branch shadows later branches (the probe exercises every branch end-to-end). Positive/support branch (all-STRICT-WIN-MEASURED -> SUPPORTS) and falsifying/decision-changing branches (EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED, FALSIFIES, INCONCLUSIVE) both concretely trigger. Thresholds are arithmetically attainable on live quantities: parent vectors give eq ratios 0.944/0.895 and fetch 0.667; legacy 1.111 sits inside the 1.15 MIXED-TRADEOFF band; Wilson bars are live (12/12 -> 0.7575 >= 0.60, 11/12 -> 0.646, 10/12 -> 0.552 < 0.60, independently computed from v2.wilson_lower). Calibrated arithmetic has both sides: reuse (6,5,5,1) beats cold (8,5,5,0)/(9,5,5,0) under time-order/fetch-dominant weights and loses under repair-heavy weights (1,1,1,5); SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED is reachable from either surface alone. Which side the scored data lands on is decided by the run, not by DESIGN.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and strong baselines share carrier, substrate, seeds, perturbation classes and identifier banks and differ only in physical per-operation work (fused-probe reuse (6,5,5,1) vs cold re-derivation (8,5,5,0)/(9,5,5,0), legacy separate-probe (10-ish, full re-execution)) — a genuine, oplog-verifiable difference (V14). Cost dimensions are complete and symmetric: both arms are scored on the identical 4-tuple {http, retrieval, verification, repair}, end-to-end episode latency, and model_calls/model_tokens (0 for both); no dimension used by one comparator is omitted from the other. No ceiling/floor identity trap: functional success at 1.0 is a validity gate, not the measured advantage; the cost dynamic range is live (17 vs 18/19/20 parent counters) and latency is continuous. The open decision content is sign-identifiability on the two NEW surfaces: calibrated weights and latency can each place the verdict on either side (both_sides_exist=true under synthetic weight extremes; measured fetch-dominant weights are finite and re-measured independently at N_CAL=300 in the scored run). B-COLD/B-COLD-MIN are the only cost/latency denominators; abstention/must-fail controls are excluded from the classifier; conservative/legacy are reported sensitivities excluded from the classifier (legacy only as V13 premise).

control_sensitivity.reason: Each control is non-tautological and was verified live under the same implementation family that will score the experiment. Positive control PC-BASE-LIVENESS is computed inside every scored trial by run_trial_v3 and invalidates the trial if any of five resources fails (200, id, verified=True); the reviewer independently confirmed the carrier path fires (task_read_verified=true; contamination_instrument_live=true). Null controls NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE were run by the reviewer via the frozen runner's --liveness-only: stale=false under both, so they can remain null under the scoring implementation. Must-fire NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR is discriminative (smoke 4/4 unaffected resources flagged; parent 4/4 every trial; V15 gate invalidates if overbroad_rate <= 0.10), not tautological: the probe measures behavioral change on unaffected resources and can stay silent if the instrument is insensitive (the parent F1 failure mode). Must-fail controls B-LITERAL-REPLAY/B-NO-REPAIR face a real perturbation (reviewer ran the frozen runner's repair_signal_probe: patched=true for P1/P2/P3; out-of-support id=1 degenerate everywhere) and are gated by V4/V6. Guard liveness and false-fire are gated by V7 against both NCs. No control is given the treatment's answer; no impossible bar (all bars are live inequalities on measured quantities).

treatment_liveness.reason: The experiment's SPIDER treatment T-REPAIR-REUSE (fused-probe signal-driven local repair on the shipped carrier) produces non-null, executable behavior before any expensive arm: the reviewer, on the exact frozen runner extraction (sha ec480f38... == CANONICAL-RUNNER-V3-SHA256), confirmed distill_live=true, resolve returns EXECUTABLE with bound_action, fetch 200, verify True, and the repair-signal path generates concrete patches for all three perturbation classes (P1 endpoint rebind, P2 schema re-adoption, P3 header attach: patched=true each). The full timed treatment episode pattern (perturb -> 2 excluded warmups -> parity-ordered timed reuse/cold-L2/cold-L3 -> untimed arms -> write-set/contamination/overbroad from the timed arm) was previously smoke-executed valid end-to-end with write_set_n=1, contamination_n=0, overbroad_n=4 (prereg 8.5). No structural barrier exists between the frozen treatment and an executable episode; the scored run re-measures everything independently at n=12/class.

List judged complete.

nonblocking_findings.description: spec.json decision_rule lists V13-LEGACY_REPRODUCTION among the validity gates whose failure forces MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE, while prereg section 9 and the frozen runner treat legacy-reproduction failure as a reported caveat only (M-LEGACY-REGRESSION-REPRODUCED is computed and reported but is NOT in the runner's `invalid` list). The executable classifier (hash-bound) and prereg agree with each other; the spec prose diverges. This does not affect reachability of the primary cw/lw decision content and cannot make the experiment unanswerable, but EXECUTE/AUDIT should adjudicate V13-failure per the executable runner + prereg (reported caveat, not automatic invalidation) and the packet should carry this discrepancy explicitly so downstream does not treat it as a silent rewrite.

The v3 runner's _carrier() reports kernel/models/registry hashes on stdout but does not itself abort on mismatch (only the v2 file has an in-runner fail-closed pin via V0). Carrier identity binding therefore relies on the V1-FREEZE_BINDING/EXECUTE pre-flight comparison against freeze.json.artifact_hashes, per the prereg contract. Acceptable as designed, but the pre-flight comparison must actually be enforced at EXECUTE; a carrier-hash mismatch caught only in reporting would otherwise not refuse-to-run.

The reviewer's independent non-outcome-bearing --liveness-only probe reconfirmed the DESIGN-time mini-calibration (N=60) yields finite positive medians with fetch-dominant measured weights (~1, 0.120, 0.108, 0.0006) under which parent-like op-count vectors favor reuse on the calibrated surface. This is a feasibility signal only: no threshold, bar, or weight rule was chosen from it, the scored run re-measures at N_CAL=300 with fixed seeds, and both sides of the calibrated surface remain arithmetically possible (repair-heavy weights lose). Recorded so downstream never over-reads DESIGN probes as scored evidence for M-CALIBRATED-WIN.
